item.title: github: Industry comparisons in the Copilot impact dashboard
item.description:
The Copilot impact dashboard now adds an “Industry comparison” section. Enterprises and non-enterprise-owned organizations can compare their Copilot agentic adoption and leverage against aggregated benchmarks.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: visualstudio: Are You Getting Everything You Can from Your Visual Studio Subscription?
item.description:
The post reminds Visual Studio subscribers that their subscription may already include benefits they can use to try Azure services, access certification learning resources, and reuse UI/dashboard components. It is framed as a prompt to explore subscription perks they may be overlooking.

  • Source: Visual Studio Blog

item.title: github: Copilot impact dashboard now shows feature engagement
item.description:
The Copilot impact dashboard now includes feature engagement data, showing how many active users regularly use key Copilot features. Enterprise administrators can use it to identify widely adopted experiences and those that may need more attention.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Rule insights dashboard generally available
item.description:
The rule insights dashboard is now generally available for both repositories and organizations. It provides a visual, high-level view of how GitHub evaluates and enforces repository rules.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: azure: Announcing: Aspire 13.5 has shipped
item.description:
Aspire 13.5 has shipped. This release refreshes the dashboard and aspire.dev, expands the Interaction Service, adds cross-scope Azure references and persistent Kubernetes volumes, and introduces live terminals in the apphost.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: github: Track organization code quality trends
item.description:
GitHub’s organization-level Code Quality dashboard now has a Trends tab. It shows code quality changes across repositories over time instead of only a point-in-time view.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Copilot impact dashboard adds a return on investment section
item.description:
The Copilot impact dashboard now includes a “Potential return on investment” section. It links Copilot spend to pull request output to help estimate ROI.

  • Source: GitHub
